subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should deterministic suppression ship first as a narrow per-spawn control, or be designed as one channel/parent/skip completion-routing contract with config defaults?
rationale: Source establishes the mechanism and remaining need, but boolean versus routing enum and config versus per-spawn scope are permanent product/API choices that overlap other open proposals.

options.title: Per-spawn skip first
options.body: Expose a narrow opt-in parameter mapped to the existing internal completion gate while preserving every current default.

options.title: Unified completion target
options.body: Define one channel, parent, or skip enum across config and per-spawn surfaces before implementation.

options.title: Global policy only
options.body: Add only an `agents.defaults.subagents` suppression default and defer per-spawn routing control.

recommendation.title: Per-spawn skip first
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow opt-in parameter mapped to the existing internal completion gate while preserving every current default.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the central spawn and announce lifecycle and has the strongest history signal for this public-contract decision.
